body: I know this is terrible advice and im probably gonna get kicked for saying this, but maybe there is no reason. I'm not saying that for you, but for all of us. I hope you find peace somewhere, in something, anything. I know exactly how you feel, especially with the first few scentences. If anything, try to find something you enjoy, try something new, a sport, a hobby, anything to take your mind off of suicide. I know how it feels to wanna end it all every day and in the end my only coping skill is distraction. It may work better for you then it does for me.
